title: Evaluation of an Online Psychological Training Programme for Migraine Management
summary: A biopsychosocial, multimodal video-based online training program for people with migraine provides information and strategies for managing migraine, stress, and social factors across four sessions. It is hypothesized that participants who complete the training will differ from those who do not with regard to migraine severity and migraine management strategies as well as psychological and physical well-being. Specifically, participation in the training is expected to be associated with a reduced migraine burden, better coping and improved psychological health (lower stress, depression, and anxiety).

interventions.name: Intervention group: Participants will complete a biopsychosocial, multimodal, video-based online training programme on migraine management (4 video sessions of approximately 45–60 minutes each over 4 weeks).
Waiting-list control group: 4-week waiting period with no intervention.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adequate knowledge of German language, suffering from migraines
Exclusion criteria:
Technical difficulties when playing the training videos
